facilities.name: Cost Plus World Market - Stockton CA Distribution Center
facilities.source: Dossier (Kaleris case study, named West Coast DC); web research: Yelp, Foursquare, Manta, Yellowpages list this DC at 3610 S Airport Way, Stockton CA 95206. Truck gate is at 1735 Zephyr St (same campus, per Waze 'Cost Plus World Market Truck Gate' and dossier). West-coast store replenishment + import receiving from Port of Oakland / LA-Long Beach.

facilities.name: Cost Plus World Market - Windsor VA Distribution Center
facilities.source: Dossier (Kaleris case study, named East Coast DC; explicitly corrects internal notes that listed Salt Lake City UT). Web research: Nextdoor, CMac, Waze, chamberofcommerce.com confirm 'Cost Plus World Market Virginia Distribution Center' at 12300 Dominion Way, Windsor VA 23487 (Waze also references nearby 12300 Windsor Blvd cross-street). East-coast store replenishment + import receiving from Norfolk / Savannah ports; mixed dry + refrigerated trailers.
